reason: The cited evidence shows that MA can produce uniform nanocrystalline powders and that SPS can rapidly densify them while suppressing grain coarsening, but all examples are for high-entropy alloys (Co-Cr-Cu-Fe-Ni, Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni), not W-Cu. The specific claim that this combination yields improved thermal and mechanical properties in W-Cu is not directly supported by the cited passages.
premises: Mechanical alloying of W-Cu powders yields uniform, fine, nanocrystalline solid solutions
Spark plasma sintering can rapidly densify MA powders while suppressing grain coarsening
The combination of MA and SPS produces low-porosity W-Cu materials
Low porosity and fine microstructure improve thermal conductivity and mechanical strength relative to conventional casting or sintering
